$schema_note: nonoun-plugins repo-root doctrine manifest (issue #379). Separate from naming.manifest.json (ADR-0011 D1: that manifest stays single-purpose for naming grammar) -- this one enumerates canon-to-dependent DOCTRINE edges: a rule stated canonically in one artifact that a dependent artifact must not violate, omit, or paraphrase away from. Four edge types: verbatim-line (a dependent must, or must not, contain an exact string/pattern from canon -- mode require|forbid), ledger-sync (a ledger/index row must match the artifact it names on disk), vocab-term (dependents must use the canonical term, never a banned alias, for one concept), judgment (no mechanical check exists -- the sweep reports the edge and its owning checker as 'queued, not built', never silently drops it). Seeded from the 2026-08-16 team/coordination-surface review (issue #379's own resolved comment): 8 findings total, 5 recovered as edges below (findings 1-3 map onto issues #380/#381/#382, closed via PR #383; findings 4-5 are stated directly in #379's own issue body). Findings 6-8 could not be recovered -- see unrecovered_findings below; the array records that gap honestly rather than fabricating edges.
